relay.transcript.turn.condensed.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: collapsed turn bar fallback label). Used only when the model supplies no more specific segment label.

relay.transcript.turn.took.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: collapsed turn duration clause). {duration} is already formatted, for example 31s or 2m14s. Never claim a duration when absent.

relay.transcript.turn.actions.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: turn and tool-group action count). {label} is the formatted count, including a trailing + when the loaded history is partial. Translate the complete plural message; do not print {count} separately. Native difference: the core wraps this in `{label, select, other {...}}` for its validator; this runtime rejects a placeholder used as both select and text, so `{label}` stands directly inside `{count, plural, ...}`.

relay.transcript.turn.completed.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: screen-reader completion state). Appended to a completed condensed bar's accessible name.

relay.transcript.fold.unit.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: tool-fold count unit). One complete unit per kind. shell, python and {name} are runtime/tool names and stay untranslated. The other arm formats a raw tool name; preserve placeholders and plural/select syntax exactly. Native difference: the core writes {count, number}; this runtime has no number argument type, and rejects mixing plural and text uses of `count`, so the shell/python/other arms use `{count, plural, other {# ...}}`.

relay.transcript.fold.shell.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: shell command count unit). shell is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains shell in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.python.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: Python evaluation count unit). python is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains python in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.more.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: tool-fold overflow unit). Follows at most five count units and counts actions hidden by that display cap, not additional tool types.

relay.transcript.fold.failed_label.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: collapsed group accessible failure state). Screen-reader text accompanying the failure glyph; it does not claim a count.

relay.transcript.fold.partial_label.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: head-cut count accessible explanation). Explains that N+ is a minimum because earlier history has not loaded.

relay.transcript.older.failed.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: history paging error). Shown beside the existing Try again action at the top of the transcript.

relay.transcript.label.steered.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: condensed segment label). The segment followed a steering message.

relay.transcript.label.wake.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: condensed segment label). The segment followed a scheduled wake.

relay.transcript.label.peer.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: condensed segment label). The segment followed a peer message.

relay.transcript.label.job.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: condensed segment label). The segment followed a background job result.

relay.transcript.label.ask.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: condensed segment label). The segment contains a settled operator question.

relay.transcript.label.messages.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: mixed quiet-group label). Used when receipts from multiple families form one quiet group.

relay.transcript.composer.queued.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: composer queued prompt count). Restores the pre-redesign queued-prompt count; {count} is the number of prompts waiting, not tool calls.

relay.transcript.session.unread_refused.note: Mirrored from the core relay catalogue (local_operator/i18n/catalogues/en/relay.transcript.context.json; core role: unread-state operation refusal). Explains that unread state could not be read and that no messages were marked read. Used by both bulk and row-level mark operations.
